8.33.1. iLock_Geography.predicate_library.signal.EndSignal¶

class iLock_Geography.predicate_library.signal.EndSignal(argOrder=None, facing=True)¶

Predicate class that builds true point ‘(path, signal)’ if ‘path’ of type PATH has ‘signal’ of type SIGNAL_TYPE as its end signal.

Methods

__init__([argOrder, facing]) Constructor.
calcPred() Calculate and set the true points for the predicate.
getMatches(*pattern) Return an iterator that iterates each true point of the predicate that matches the pattern.
getSignature() Return the signature of the predicate.
getType(typeName) Return the GeoType object with the given typeName.
getValue(*args) Return c{True} if the given object tuple is a true point of the predicate.
isInDomain(*args) Return True is the objects the tuple args are in the domains of the corresponding geo type in the signature.
isSubDomain(*pattern) Return True if the objects contained in the pattern are in the domains of the signature of the predicate.
name() Return the name of this predicate.
setSignature() Set the signature for the predicate.
toLCFTable(table_id) Translate geo predicate to LCF table.
